title: Simple Waypoint Mod
description: A very simple Waypoint mod works on single player and multiplayer servers
body:
This is a very simple lightweight waypoint mod Works on single player and multiplayer servers

Features

Create waypoints
edit waypoints
Delete waypoints
Hide and unhide waypoints
Nameable waypoints
Color wheel
Works in all dimensions including custom dimensions

Just a very basic lightweight waypoint mod

Press M your keyboard to open menu
